source.official_agency: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

visa_fraud_warning.summary_ko: 일본 외무성은 워킹홀리데이 프로그램 운영과 관련하여 일본 내 특정 단체와 협력하지 않으므로, 외무성 협력 기관을 사칭하는 비자 지원 단체에 주의
visa_fraud_warning.evidence_text: Please beware of fraudulent entities that allege to offer help in obtaining working holiday visas as there is no organization, including incorporated associations, in Japan with which the Ministry of Foreign Affairs cooperates in operating the working holiday programmes.

employment_support.responsible_reference_agency: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare
employment_support.evidence_text: Foreign job-seekers in Japan may seek assistance in English or other languages at the Employment Service Centre for Foreigners (in Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka and Fukuoka) as well as at some of the regional national public employment security offices (‘Hello Work’). Please check the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare's website for the detail. ( Information for foreigners who are seeking jobs in Japan ).

post_programme_questionnaire.evidence_text: We may request working holiday programmes participants to answer a questionnaire after completing their programmes. We would appreciate your cooperation in this regard.

original_text: Please beware of fraudulent entities that allege to offer help in obtaining working holiday visas as there is no organization, including incorporated associations, in Japan with which the Ministry of Foreign Affairs cooperates in operating the working holiday programmes. Foreign job-seekers in Japan may seek assistance in English or other languages at the Employment Service Centre for Foreigners (in Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka and Fukuoka) as well as at some of the regional national public employment security offices (‘Hello Work’). Please check the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare's website for the detail. ( Information for foreigners who are seeking jobs in Japan ). We may request working holiday programmes participants to answer a questionnaire after completing their programmes. We would appreciate your cooperation in this regard.
